questions.section: East Coast and Northern Territory Tourism Services
questions.text: How closely do Journey Beyond and Kelsian compete for the supply of tourism experiences and services in the following areas:

questions.section: East Coast and Northern Territory Tourism Services
questions.text: If you are a provider of tour services at K’gari/Fraser Island, which ferry service operators do you use and why.
How closely do Journey Beyond and Kelsian compete for the supply of ferry services from Perth and/or Fremantle to Rottnest Island?
Who are alternative suppliers of ferry services from Perth and/or Fremantle to Rottnest Island?
To what extent is Rottnest Fast Ferries an alternative?
Provide details of how suppliers of ferry services from Perth and/or Fremantle to Rottnest Island compete (e.g. pricing, frequency of services, service quality, location, bundled tour offerings)?
What factors do customers consider most important when choosing a ferry operator?

What are the barriers to entry and/or expansion for the supply of ferry services from Perth and/or Fremantle? In your response, you may wish to refer to costs (such as capital expenditure for new vessels), necessary inputs (such as access to berth and availability of time slots), and any other barriers.
How difficult would it be for a new operator to commence supplying ferry services to Rottnest Island?

Please provide any additional information or comments that you consider relevant to the ACCC’s assessment of the Acquisitions, including any potential effects on businesses operating on Rottnest Island.
